repos.name: api
repos._model: Per-repo override; omit it to inherit the top-level model.

repos.name: builtin-skills-repo
repos._skillPath: builtin: uses the generic skills shipped in this package's skills/ directory instead of a repo-local copy.
repos._skillOverlayPath: Optional. A repo-relative file appended after the skill; revisionSkillOverlayPath does the same for revise.

_review_phase: Optional. Enable the Review phase to auto-review feature PRs. Disabled by default. Review runs through the Tech Lead: set techLeadPath to its checkout and put TECHLEAD_GITHUB_KEY (the reviewer's own GitHub token) in the environment. Per-repo overrides: add reviewEnabled or reviewerLogin to a repos[] entry.
